# Modern Angular for Professionals – learning path

Work through the stages in order. Each step is a read, a video, something to explore in the running app, code to study, an exercise or a self-check. Tick steps as you finish them; your progress is saved in this browser.

- **Foundations:** New to Angular or to frontend frameworks: do every step in order (6 weeks).
- **Accelerated:** Already fluent in a component framework: skim weeks 1–2 and spend the time on the accelerated exercises (3–4 weeks).

| Order | Stage | Hours | Steps | Ends with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | [Week 1: Foundations](week-1.md) | 8 | 10 | – |
| 2 | [Week 2: Signals and components](week-2.md) | 9 | 9 | Checkpoint 1: components and signals |
| 3 | [Week 3: Services, DI, state and routing](week-3.md) | 8 | 9 | – |
| 4 | [Week 4: Data and async](week-4.md) | 10 | 11 | Checkpoint 2: data, routing and DI |
| 5 | [Week 5: Forms, pipes, directives, i18n and theming](week-5.md) | 9 | 15 | – |
| 6 | [Module: Startup logic and config-driven content](module-config.md) | 6 | 9 | – |
| 7 | [Week 6: Quality, performance and the capstone](week-6.md) | 10 | 11 | Checkpoint 3: capstone demo |

Prefer clicking? Run the app and open **Learn** (`/learn`): same steps, with progress tracking.
